name: @w6w-apps/rendex
description: Capture screenshots and PDFs of URLs, HTML and Markdown, extract page content and monitor pages for changes with Rendex.

w6w.longDescription:
Rendex is a rendering API: it loads a page in real Chrome and hands back a screenshot or PDF, renders HTML or Markdown (optionally filled from a Mustache template and a data object) to an image or PDF, and turns a page into clean reader-mode Markdown. It is a quick way to produce invoices, certificates, OG images, page archives and LLM-ready page text from a workflow without running a browser.

This app covers rendering a URL, HTML or Markdown to PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF (returned as base64), minting signed hosted render links for og:image and img tags, extracting page content, building branded PDF/PNG artifacts with share links, queueing asynchronous screenshot batches and reading their jobs, reading plan and credit usage, and Rendex Watch: create, test, list, run, pause, update and delete page-change monitors and read their run history.

Every render spends credits and Rendex takes no idempotency key, so the rendering actions are not marked retry-safe. On the Free plan images carry a light rendex.dev watermark.
